description: This file defines a CKEditor dialog plugin for managing 'select' HTML elements, including options and their properties.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Creates and adds an 'OPTION' element to a 'select' element, setting its text and value.

methods.name: c
methods.description: Removes all 'option' children from a 'select' element and repopulates it.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Modifies the text and value of an 'option' at a specific index.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Removes all child elements from a 'select' element.

methods.name: f
methods.description: Moves an 'option' element up or down within the options list.

methods.name: g
methods.description: Returns the index of the selected option in a 'select' element.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Sets the selected index of a 'select' element.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Returns the children of a given element.

methods.name: j
methods.description: Retrieves the input element from a given element.
